mapping_notes: Published A4 (FTEs repurposed) is 1.5 / 3.9 / 6.0 at $100,000 each. The printed A2 for Year 2 (7 FTEs) times 55% gives 3.85, not 3.9, so A2 is printed rounded; we start from the published A4 and use adoption_by_year = A4 / 6 = 25 / 65 / 100.
The value is repurposed FTE capacity at full salary, so recapture is 100%. We use 6 staff x 40 hours x 50 weeks x $50 per hour = $600,000 at full scale.

inputs.published_as: a full FTE is repurposed (our convention)
capacity repurposed is valued at full salary

tolerance.why: whole-dollar rounding; arithmetic exact once A4 is taken as printed
